name: Civil unrest
summary: France braces for 5 Nov general strike after 410,000 marched
state: About 410,000 people marched across France on 31 Oct, with isolated clashes after mostly peaceful marches, and unions have called a general strike for 5 Nov (Latin Times; Denver Gazette). Protests in Germany turned violent on 1 Nov. No deaths have been reported.
for_you: Expect transport disruption in France on 5 Nov; check FCDO advice and avoid demonstrations.
rubric_hit: Significant protests in several countries = Watch

sources.title: Latin Times — France protests: unions set 5 Nov general strike
Denver Gazette — Isolated clashes in France after peaceful marches

why: Mass protest and state crackdowns signal political fragility and can topple governments.
drivers: Cost of living, elections, corruption, repression, food and fuel prices.

rubric.alert: Deadly nationwide unrest or a state crackdown in a major country.
rubric.watch: Significant protests in several countries or deadly unrest in one.
rubric.normal: No deadly mass unrest in large countries.
